name: Bloom of the Well
description: What the Exile Scare taught her: beauty has consequences. This spell makes flowers break open from almost anything, and the result is always a little too much. The well ran with blossoms for a week. Her hands still shake when she thinks about it.

params.message: Blossoms erupt from the ground in a glorious, messy cascade.
The air turns sweet and the light softens.
She watches the flowers bloom and smiles, then winces. "Not too much... not too much..."
